Savonlinna is 141 road km from the nearest unit by drive time (Joensuu), and 15 breast sessions mean 16 nights away versus 6 with 5 [S60, S59].

1. The KYS radiotherapy lead could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases, with equal pain relief but more retreatment, serving "National targets and key effectiveness indicators defined for agreed cancers" [S31, S30, S61]. Savonlinna patients expect 6.2 nights away with multi-fraction treatment versus 2.4 with a single 8 Gy session [S60, S30]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews which cases could default to it [S31].

2. The KYS breast oncology lead could evaluate 5 sessions as default for eligible patients (whole breast or chest wall, no nodal radiotherapy), with distance as a reason, which is non-inferior to 15, serving "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S9, S15, S14, S25, S24]. This would remove 353 nights away and free 440 machine sessions a year (calculated) [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews eligibility criteria for 5 sessions [S15, S14].

3. The quality manager could evaluate yearly publication of schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band, serving "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S21, S27, S26]. Within 30 days, the quality manager and the clinical team decide which figures to report [S16].

Distances are modelled and the current schedule mix is unknown [S59, S16].
